manifest.name: dsh-sensenova-freeapi
manifest.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for SenseNova (OpenAI-compatible). Registers the 'sensenova' provider route with multi-account API-key rotation, a Models-page card, and a live model catalog.

bundle.text:
# dsh-sensenova-freeapi bundle patch
#
# 通过 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-sensenova-freeapi` 安装时,该声明会把
# 本包追加进 dsh.profile.bundles,profile 启动时合并此 patch(单一 insert 行)。
# `name` 必须是 scoped 全名(加载器按真实包名从 node_modules 解析),YAML 中以 @ 开头的
# 标量必须加引号,否则解析失败。
#
# 可选行内 config(优先级低于 settings.yaml 的 llm-sensenova 段):
#
#   - insert:
#       - id: llm-sensenova
#         name: "dsh-sensenova-freeapi"
#         config:
#           apiKeyEnv: SENSENOVA_API_KEY
- insert:
    - id: llm-sensenova
      name: "dsh-sensenova-freeapi"
      config:
        apiKeyEnv: SENSENOVA_API_KEY

readme.text:
**简体中文** ｜ [English](./README.en.md) dsh-sensenova-freeapi 是一个非官方的 **DeepSeek Harness**（DSH）LLM 提供商插件，基于**一切皆插件（everything-is-a-plugin）**架构注册 `sensenova` 提供商路由，对接 **SenseNova**（OpenAI 兼容 API）。它内置**多账户 API-Key 轮换**、**运行态 / 阻塞态双列表状态机**、实时模型目录与 Models 页设置面板，把渠道限流从「错误轰炸」变成「稳定服务」。

> ⚠️ **如果插件安装出现问题**：用**无插件模式**进入 DSH，然后用**大肥鱼**修一下，最多 **0.5 元**可以搞定。 > ⭐ **测试与制作不易，使用后麻烦给个 Star 以表支持，谢谢！**

> 参考实现：[`@mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider`](https://github.com/Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider)（MIT）。本插件只保留多账户连接能力；登录流程、用量面板、套餐窗口、命令行工具均已裁剪。

---

readme.section: 通过 DSH 插件界面安装（推荐）
readme.text:
1. 打开 DSH 的**插件安装**界面
2. 在安装地址输入框中填入：

```
https://github.com/modesthub/dsh-sensenova-freeapi
```

3. 确认安装，然后**重启 DSH** 使插件生效
4. 安装后可在**插件详情页**看到当前版本号（本 README 对应 **v0.5.0**）

- 在插件安装界面**重新输入同一个地址**（或先卸载再安装）即可拉取最新代码
- 更新后**重启 DSH**，插件详情页的版本号会随之变化 —— 这是确认是否更新成功最直接的方式
- 想固定到某个版本，可在地址后追加 tag，例如 `https://github.com/modesthub/dsh-sensenova-freeapi#v0.5.0`
```bash

readme.section: GitHub（推荐，装完即可用，lib/ 已预构建）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:modesthub/dsh-sensenova-freeapi

readme.section: 本地路径（用于开发调试）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile <name> add /path/to/dsh-sensenova-freeapi
```

安装后到「模型」页配置 SenseNova：
- 默认凭据环境变量：`SENSENOVA_API_KEY`
- 默认 base URL：`https://token.sensenova.cn/v1`

---
到 [https://platform.sensenova.cn/login](https://platform.sensenova.cn/login) 注册并登录（支持手机号 / 邮箱）。

readme.section: 2. 在控制台申请多个 API Key
readme.text: 进入控制台 [https://platform.sensenova.cn/console](https://platform.sensenova.cn/console)，在「API Key 管理」中创建密钥。**每个账户最多可申请 20 把 Key**。注意额度是按**账户**计量的（同一账户内多把 Key 共享一个桶），但同账户内多把 Key 能显著提升「抽签次数」——实测同账户 20 把成功率约 90%，单把只有 30%。 > 📷 账户配置界面示意（控制台申请多个 API Key 的位置）：

readme.section: 3. 建议注册多个账户（推荐 4 个）
readme.text:
SenseNova 的限流额度是**账户级 / 端点级**的（同一账户内多把 Key 共享同一个额度桶），因此**把 API Key 分散到 ≥ 2 个账户**才能绕开单账户瓶颈。

- **多账户是关键**：每个账户拥有独立限流额度桶，账户数 = 桶数。实测 4 账户 × 20 把 = 4 个独立桶 × 20 次抽签，成功率从单账户 30% 拉到接近 100%。
- 本插件运行态/阻塞态双列表 + 账户轮换就是为「多账户」设计的。

readme.section: 4. 账户顺序：插件会**自动按账户交替**轮换
readme.text:
你把账户按什么顺序配置都可以 —— 插件在轮换时会按 label 的「序号→账户」自动重排，得到跨账户交错的顺序：

```
A1  B1  A2  B2  A3  B3  …（即 121212 交替）
```

这样每把 Key 之间天然错位，轮换时不会在同一账户内打转，显著降低单账户触顶概率。

- **推荐配置：4 个账户 × 每账户 20 把**（SenseNova 每账户最多 20 把）。

实测结论（2026-10，晚高峰 10 轮对照）：

| 同账户 key 数 | 成功率 | 期望耗时 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1 把 | 30% | 27.9s |
  | 5 把 | 40% | 27.1s |
  | 10 把 | 40% | 27.8s |
  | 15 把 | 70% | 21.9s |
  | **20 把** | **90%** | **17.2s** |

readme.section: 4. 账户顺序：插件会**自动按账户交替**轮换
readme.text: **成功率拐点在 15~20 把**；20 把同账户 ≈ 跨账户 20 把（90% vs 100%）。每账户 20 把，4 账户就是 4 个独立桶 × 20 次机会，晚高峰也基本不失败。

| 模型 | 能力 / 说明 | 推荐度 |
|---|---|---|
| **`deepseek-v4-flash`** | **首选**。DeepSeek V4 Flash（0731），任意时段使用都只比 DeepSeek 官方 API **慢一点点**；低成本、1M 上下文、支持思考/工具调用 | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` | `6.8-flash-lite` 走轻量专属额度池，**真视觉**（读图、截图唯一可靠）、墙钟最快（26.6× 提速） | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐（读图首选） |
| `kimi-k3` | 月之暗面旗舰多模态 Agent，原生态视觉 + 1M 上下文，适合长程编程/知识工作 | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| `glm-5.2` | 智谱长程 Agent，**持续吞吐最高**（比 `deepseek-flash` 快 201%、延迟快 45%），但**无视觉**（读图会幻觉） | ⭐⭐⭐⭐（纯文本/长程） |
| ⚠️ `deepseek-flash`（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash） | **不建议**：实测高峰期很慢、低峰期也只能达到官网 API 一半速度及以下 | ❌ |
> 💡 **一句话结论**：日常/代码/Agent 用 `deepseek-v4-flash`；要读图用 `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite`；追求极限文本吞吐且不读图用 `glm-5.2`。**不要用 `deepseek-flash`（V4.1）**。

> 🔭 **搭配推荐（视觉辅助）**：主模型用 `deepseek-v4-flash`（快且稳、成本低），图片识别交给视觉辅助插件 —— 安装 [`dsh-sensenova-vision-aid`](https://github.com/modesthub/dsh-sensenova-vision-aid) 后，收到图片识别请求会自动派生子 agent 切换到 SenseNova 视觉模型（`sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` → `deepseek-flash` → `kimi-k3` 故障转移），并**自动复用本插件同一把 key**（默认 `reuseFreeapiCredentials=true`，无需再配第二把 key）。**最合适的组合：`deepseek-v4-flash` 处理文本/代码/Agent + vision-aid 辅助视觉**，又快又好。

---

| 按钮 | 位置 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| **导出全部 Key** | 导入 / 导出 Key 卡片 | 拉取全部账户（含默认账户）的密钥，以明文写入文本框 |
| **导入到账户** | 同上 | 解析文本框内容并写入**草稿**（保存按钮亮起，点保存才生效） |
| **清空文本框** | 同上 | 清空导入 / 导出文本框内容 |
| **刷新** | 页面标题右侧 | 手动重查全部账户的凭据状态（兜底；正常会自动刷新） |
| **清空全部** | 多账户轮换卡片标题右侧 | 二次确认（3 秒内再点）后**暂存移除全部额外账户**；点「保存」才删账户 + 清除凭据，默认账户保留 |
| **保存 / 重置** | 页面底部 | 保存所有草稿（导入、清空、编辑）／放弃未保存的修改 |

> 🔒 导出文本是**明文密钥**：只在本机设置页显示，插件不上传、不落盘；请自行决定保存位置（建议放在密码管理器）。

---

设置页「凭据与账户」下方新增 **导入 / 导出 Key** 卡片：

**导出**：点「导出全部 Key」→ 全部账户（含默认账户）的密钥以明文写入文本框，格式与手工整理的密钥文件一致：

```

Default:sk-...

账户2
0:sk-...
1:sk-...
```

**导入**：把上述文本（或你自己整理的「账户N / 序号:密钥」「标签:密钥」）粘进文本框，点「导入到账户」：
导入**只写草稿**，页面底部「**保存**」按钮会亮起 —— 点它才真正写凭据并更新账户列表（`accounts`）。

- 标签与已有账户相同 → 覆盖该账户的密钥（不改账户结构）
- 新标签 → 从 `SENSENOVA_API_KEY_2` 起分配新 credential-ref 并追加账户
- `Default` / `1-0` → 写入默认账户
- 重复密钥、非法行会被跳过并在下方提示（不阻断其它行）

---

readme.section: 📊 作者实测：时间效率排名
readme.text:
以下为作者长期实际使用后的主观体感排名（**时间效率**优先，非跑分）：

| 排名 | 模型 | 时间效率 | 犯错率 | 适用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🥇 **1** | `glm-5.2` | **最快**（小任务尤其明显） | 偏高（复杂任务需复核） | 小任务、短程问答、纯文本批量处理 |
| 🥈 **2** | `deepseek-v4-flash` | 较快 | **较低** | **日常主力**：代码、Agent、长程任务 |
| 🥉 **3** | `deepseek-flash` | 偏慢（时间利用率仍较低） | 中等 | **晚间自动化任务主力**（夜里限流轻、可慢跑） |

> 💡 `glm-5.2` 小任务飞快但犯错率可能高一些；`deepseek-v4-flash` 速度与正确性平衡最好，日常用它足够；`deepseek-flash` 白天时间利用率低，但**夜间跑自动化任务**很稳。

readme.section: 本次大更新：为 `deepseek-flash` 抢回时间利用率
readme.text:
本次大更新的核心目标，就是**优化 `deepseek-flash` 的时间利用率** —— 通过**多账户、多 key、交替排布**等策略，在多次重复测试后，找到时间利用率最高的方法。

三重手段各自解决一段问题：

| 手段 | 作用 | 解决什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **账户数** | 增加配额（每个账户是独立额度桶） | 从**源头**解决限速 |
| **Key 数** | 增加「抽卡」速度（一次 429 后能快速多试几把） | 从**换 key** 角度缓解限速 |
| **Key 排布策略** | 优化分流（交替排布让前几次尝试覆盖多个独立桶） | 让**同样的尝试次数覆盖更多配额** |

> 实测依据见下文「为什么能长时间稳定运行」与「轮换机制」两节：同账户 20 key 成功率 90%（单把仅 30%），交替排布 72% vs 顺序排布 50%。

---

readme.section: 核心思想：把「限流」当作常态设计
readme.text:
SenseNova 渠道对单 key 存在 **TPM / RPM 并发与配额限制**，瞬时超限会抛 `429`。多数插件的做法是报错 + 重试，连续限流时陷入**正反馈死锁**：计数只在 2xx 清零 → 短路导致零成功 → 计数永不清零 → 短路永不解除 → 只能重启进程。

本插件换了一个思路：**限流不是事故，是运行常态**。用两个显式列表管理每一把 API Key 的状态：

readme.section: 运行态 / 阻塞态双列表状态机
readme.text: 三条不可让步的性质（与旧「全池短路」机制的本质区别）： 1. **保底**：运行态只剩 1 把 key 时永不踢出 ⇒ 池永不空，Agent 请求永远发得出去。 2. **借用**：运行态候选被排除排空时，从阻塞态借「阻塞最久」的一把临时使用（**不修改其相位**）。 3. **恢复与请求解耦**：阻塞态 Key 的相位**只由探测结果决定**，不受「零成功」污染，随时能把 key 救回运行态。**这是根治旧死锁的关键。**

readme.section: 运行态 / 阻塞态双列表状态机
readme.text:
> 为什么必须探测恢复：Agent 请求只会选中运行态的 Key，阻塞态的 Key 不会被任何请求命中。若无人试探，它就永远回不来——调度器每 `probeInitialMs`（默认 3s，2026-10 实测调密）用一次最小请求探一下，成功即复活。

---

readme.section: 轮换机制：先原地重试，再换 key
readme.text:
**撞 429 后的完整处理链路**：

1. **插件内原地等重试**：同一把 key 等 `deepseek-flash` 15s / `deepseek-v4-flash` 10s，最多 1 次。成功即继续 —— 不换 key、不产生日志噪音。
2. **换 key 轮换**：仍失败且 `quotaRotation=true`（推荐）时，从上次使用的 key 的**下一个位置**在运行态里环回，跳过本轮已试过的 key（`exclude`），避免旧实现「前两把反复、第 3+ 把轮不到」的问题。
3. **借用阻塞态**：运行态候选全部被排除时，从阻塞态借用「阻塞最久」的一把临时使用（**不改变其相位**），使一轮内仍能试满全部 key。
4. **抛宿主**：全部 key 都失败才抛给宿主（指数退避 15~19s，最多 24 次重试）。

**实测对照（强制 429 后 6 轮，deepseek-flash / 80 key / 24k tokens）**：

readme.section: 轮换机制：先原地重试，再换 key
readme.text:
| 策略 | 成功率 | 成功均耗时 | 耗时范围 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`quotaRotation=true`**（先 15s 重试，再换 key） | **6/6（100%）** | **27.9s** | **25.9~28.7s** |
| `quotaRotation=false`（先 15s 重试，不换 key） | 4/6（67%） | 36.9s | 27.4~46.4s（2 次失败在 50s） |

> 为什么轮换更快：换 key 的成本是 **0.2s/把**（平均试 2~4 把就命中），而宿主退避是 **17s/次**。即使多撞几次 429，轮换的总耗时也稳定在「15s 等待 + 12~15s 生成」≈ 28s；不换 key 则只能等宿主退避，撞两次就是 45~50s 甚至失败。

readme.section: 轮换机制：先原地重试，再换 key
readme.text:
**轮换顺序（v0.2.6 自动交替）**：账户 label 形如 `账户号-序号`（`Default` 视为 `1-0`）时，插件按 **(序号, 账户号)** 排序后轮换，即 `1-0 → 2-0 → 3-0 → 4-0 → 1-1 → 2-1 …`。这样前 4 次尝试就覆盖 **4 个独立额度桶**；若按配置顺序（某账户的 20 把全在前），前 19 次尝试都花在同一个桶上。18 轮实测（20 次尝试上限）：**交替成功率 72% / 顺序 50%**，限流轮次下交替均 10 次尝试、顺序均 16 次。label 不满足该格式时保持配置顺序。

**状态与限流分类**：

readme.section: 轮换机制：先原地重试，再换 key
readme.text:
- 只有 **tpm 类 429** 才会累计「连续命中」，达到 `kickThreshold`（默认 2）才把 key 踢进阻塞态；`rpm` / `rate` 类只记录、不踢出（秒级桶自愈快，踢掉只会损失 prompt cache）。
- **保底**：运行态只剩 1 把时永不踢出，池不会空，agent 请求永远发得出去。
- **401（凭据无效）**：永久禁用并从池中移除，不受 `quotaRotation` 开关影响。
- **会话粘性**：轮换后会话粘住新 key（保护服务端 prompt 缓存）；请求成功即清除粘性，让环回游标主导下一次选择。
- **探针的已知局限**：阻塞态探针是最小请求（`max_tokens: 1`、关闭思考），只能代表「请求数桶」恢复，不能完全代表大请求（TPM）恢复；大请求的真实可用性以 agent 请求本身为准。

---

readme.section: 为什么能「长时间稳定运行」——长程实测支撑
readme.text:
| 实测项 | 结论 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 429 处理顺序 | **先原地重试 1 次，再换 key**（deepseek-flash 15s / v4-flash 10s） | 6 轮强制 429 对照：成功率 100% vs 67%，耗时 27.9s vs 36.9s |
| `quotaRotation` | **开启**（换 key 是低成本快速抽签，0.2s/把） | 同上：不换 key 时宿主退避 17s/次，撞两次即 45~50s |
| 同账户 Key 数收益 | 20 把成功率 **90%**（单把 30%）；拐点在 15~20 把 | 晚高峰 10 轮 × 5 档对照 |
| 池容量 | **100**（容纳 4 账户 × 20 把） | 2026-10 扩容实测 |
| 探测间隔 | **3s 固定**（`probeBackoffFactor=1`，不放大） | 实测调密：更快把恢复的 key 捞回运行态 |
| 探测恢复 | 外部调度器每 tick 至多探 1 把（防探测自身形成突发） | 设计 |
| 双列表状态机 | 取代「全池饱和短路」正反馈死锁 | 重构 |
| 环回轮换修复 | 排除项后必须从下一位置环回 | 9265 条 429 日志统计 |
| Retry-After 上限 | 提到 `60_000ms`（原 3000ms 与 TPM 60s 窗口量级不符） | 长程实测 |
| 排队超时 | 默认 60s，与 TPM 窗口对齐，排队必须有界 | design D4/D6 实测 |

readme.section: 为什么能「长时间稳定运行」——长程实测支撑
🧠 双列表 Key 池（运行 / 阻塞）
readme.text:
- 池级单例、跨会话共享：Key 的额度是全局属性，不该被会话隔离。

dsh-sensenova-freeapi is an unofficial **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH) LLM provider plugin. Built on the **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture, it registers the `sensenova` provider route to connect to **SenseNova** (an OpenAI-compatible API). It ships with **multi-account API-key rotation**, a **running/blocked dual-list state machine**, a live model catalog, and a Models-page settings panel, turning channel rate-limit spam into a stable service.

> ⚠️ **If the plugin fails to install**: enter DSH through **plugin-less mode**, then repair it with **Da Fei Yu (大肥鱼)** — it costs at most **¥0.5**. > ⭐ **Testing and building this took real effort — if it helps you, please give the repo a Star. Thank you!**

> Reference implementation: [`@mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider`](https://github.com/Mars-Sea/dsh-commandcode-provider) (MIT). This plugin keeps only the multi-account connectivity; the login flow, usage dashboard, plan window, and CLI tooling are all trimmed away.

Sign up and log in at [https://platform.sensenova.cn/login](https://platform.sensenova.cn/login).

readme.section: 2. Issue multiple API keys from the console
readme.text: Open the console at [https://platform.sensenova.cn/console](https://platform.sensenova.cn/console), then create keys under **API Key management**. **Each account allows up to 20 keys.** Note that the allowance is metered **per account** (all keys in one account share a single bucket), but multiple keys in the same account significantly raise the number of "draws" — measured: 20 keys in one account succeed ~90% of the time vs 30% with a single key.

readme.section: 2. Issue multiple API keys from the console
readme.text: > 📷 Account configuration screen (where to issue multiple API keys):

SenseNova limits are **account- / endpoint-scoped** — multiple keys inside the *same* account share a single quota bucket. So spreading keys across **≥ 2 accounts** is what actually bypasses the single-account bottleneck.

- **Accounts are the key lever**: each account owns an independent quota bucket, so account count = bucket count. Measured: 4 accounts × 20 keys = 4 independent buckets × 20 draw chances, lifting the success rate from ~30% (single key) to ~100%.
- This plugin's running/blocked dual-list + account rotation is built exactly for the multi-account case.

readme.section: 4. Account order: the plugin interleaves accounts automatically
readme.text:
Configure accounts in any order — at rotation time the plugin re-sorts by the label's “slot → account” pair, producing a cross-account interleaved order:

```
A1  B1  A2  B2  A3  B3  …  (i.e. 121212 alternating)
```

This naturally staggers every key so rotation never spins inside one account, greatly lowering the chance of hitting a single account's ceiling.

- **Recommended setup: 4 accounts × 20 keys each** (SenseNova allows up to 20 keys per account).

readme.section: 4. Account order: the plugin interleaves accounts automatically
readme.text:
Measured (2026-10 peak hour, 10 rounds):

| Keys in one account | Success rate | Expected time |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1 key | 30% | 27.9s |
  | 5 keys | 40% | 27.1s |
  | 10 keys | 40% | 27.8s |
  | 15 keys | 70% | 21.9s |
  | **20 keys** | **90%** | **17.2s** |

**The knee is at 15-20 keys**; 20 keys in one account ≈ 20 keys across accounts (90% vs 100%). With 20 keys per account, 4 accounts give 4 independent buckets × 20 chances — rarely failing even at peak.
The following are taken from long-running measurements (2026-09), ordered by use case:

| Model | Capability / Notes | Rating |
|---|---|---|
| **`deepseek-v4-flash`** | **First choice.** DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731); only *slightly* slower than the official DeepSeek API at any time of day; low-cost, 1M context, thinking + tool-calling | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` | `6.8-flash-lite` uses a lightweight dedicated quota pool, has **real vision** (the only reliable one for reading images/screenshots), and the fastest wall-clock (26.6× speedup) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (vision first) |
| `kimi-k3` | Moonshot flagship multimodal agent; native vision + 1M context; good for long-horizon coding and knowledge work | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ |
| `glm-5.2` | Zhipu long-horizon model; **highest sustained throughput** (201% faster than `deepseek-flash`, 45% lower latency), but **no vision** (hallucinates on images) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (text/long-run) |
| ⚠️ `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) | **Not recommended:** very slow at peak, and only reaches ≤ half the official API speed even off-peak | ❌ |

> 💡 **Bottom line:** use `deepseek-v4-flash` for daily/code/agent work; `sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` when you need image understanding; `glm-5.2` for pure-text maximum throughput. **Avoid `deepseek-flash` (V4.1).**

> 🔭 **Pairing recommendation (vision assist):** run the main model on `deepseek-v4-flash` (fast, stable, low-cost) and leave image recognition to the vision-assist plugin — install [`dsh-sensenova-vision-aid`](https://github.com/modesthub/dsh-sensenova-vision-aid), which spawns a child agent switched to the SenseNova vision model (`sensenova-6.8-flash-lite` → `deepseek-flash` → `kimi-k3` failover) and **reuses this plugin's key automatically** (default `reuseFreeapiCredentials=true`, no second key needed). **Best combination: `deepseek-v4-flash` for text/code/agent work + vision-aid for images — fast and reliable.**

readme.section: This big update: winning back time efficiency for `deepseek-flash`
readme.text:
The goal of this release is to **improve `deepseek-flash` time efficiency** — via **multiple accounts, many keys, and interleaved layout**, validated through many repeated test runs to find the highest time-utilisation configuration.

Three levers, each solving a different problem:

readme.section: This big update: winning back time efficiency for `deepseek-flash`
readme.text:
| Lever | Effect | What it solves |
|---|---|---|
| **Account count** | More quota (each account is an independent bucket) | Fixes throttling **at the source** |
| **Key count** | Faster “draws” (many quick retries after a 429) | Eases throttling **via key switching** |
| **Key layout** | Better distribution (interleaving covers several buckets in the first few tries) | **Same attempts, more quota covered** |

readme.section: This big update: winning back time efficiency for `deepseek-flash`
readme.text:
> See “Why it runs stably” and “Rotation” below: 20 keys in one account reach 90% (a single key only 30%); interleaved layout 72% vs sequential 50%.

---

readme.section: Core idea: design around throttling as a norm
readme.text: SenseNova imposes **TPM / RPM concurrency and quota limits** per key, and a burst over the limit returns `429`. Most plugins just retry, which collapses into a **positive-feedback deadlock** under sustained throttling: the counter only resets on 2xx → short-circuiting yields zero success → the counter never resets → short-circuit never lifts → the process must be restarted.

readme.section: Core idea: design around throttling as a norm
readme.text: This plugin flips the thinking: **throttling is not an accident, it is the steady state.** Two explicit lists manage the state of every API key:
Three non-negotiable properties (the essential difference from the legacy whole-pool short-circuit):

1. **Floor** — when only 1 key remains in running, it is never kicked ⇒ the pool never empties and agent requests always go out.
2. **Borrow** — when running candidates are all excluded, borrow the *longest-blocked* key temporarily (**without changing its phase**).
3. **Recovery decoupled from requests** — a blocked key's phase is decided **only by probe results**, never polluted by "zero success", so it can be revived at any time. **This is what roots out the old deadlock.**

> Why probing must exist: agent requests only ever target running keys — a blocked key is never hit. Unless someone probes it, it can never recover. The scheduler probes once every `probeInitialMs` (default 3s, the same order as the request-bucket refill cycle) with a minimal request, and revives the key on success.

---

readme.section: Rotation: retry in place first, then switch keys
readme.text:
1. **In-plugin retry in place** — wait on the same key for `deepseek-flash` 15s / `deepseek-v4-flash` 10s, at most once. On success: continue, no key switch, no log noise.
2. **Key rotation** — if it still fails and `quotaRotation=true` (recommended), scan the **running list** round-robin from the position after the last-used key, skipping keys already tried in this request (`exclude`). This avoids the legacy "first two ping-pong, key #3+ never used" bug.
3. **Borrow from blocked** — when all running candidates are excluded, borrow the *longest-blocked* key temporarily (**without changing its phase**), so a round can still try every key.
4. **Throw to host** — only when every key fails (exponential backoff 15-19s, up to 24 retries).

readme.section: Rotation: retry in place first, then switch keys
readme.text:
**Measured comparison (6 forced-429 rounds, deepseek-flash / 80 keys / 24k tokens)**

| Strategy | Success | Avg time (success) | Range |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`quotaRotation=true`** (15s retry, then key rotation) | **6/6 (100%)** | **27.9s** | **25.9-28.7s** |
| `quotaRotation=false` (15s retry, no key switch) | 4/6 (67%) | 36.9s | 27.4-46.4s (2 failures at 50s) |

readme.section: Rotation: retry in place first, then switch keys
readme.text: > Why rotation is faster: a key switch costs **0.2s each** (2-4 keys usually hit), while host backoff costs **17s per retry**. Even with more 429s, rotation stays at "15s wait + 12-15s generation" ≈ 28s; without rotation you can only wait for host backoff — two retries already cost 45-50s, or fail outright.

readme.section: Rotation: retry in place first, then switch keys
readme.text: **Rotation order (auto-interleaved since v0.2.6)**: when labels look like `account-slot` (`Default` counts as `1-0`), the plugin sorts by **(slot, account)** before rotating: `1-0 → 2-0 → 3-0 → 4-0 → 1-1 → 2-1 …`. The first 4 attempts therefore cover **4 independent quota buckets**, whereas a config-ordered list (all 20 keys of one account first) spends its first 19 attempts in a single bucket. Measured over 18 rounds (20-attempt cap): **interleaved 72% vs sequential 50%** success; on throttled rounds interleaved needed 10 attempts vs 16. Labels outside this format keep the configured order.

readme.section: Rotation: retry in place first, then switch keys
readme.text:
- Only **tpm-type 429s** accumulate consecutive strikes; after `kickThreshold` (default 2) the key is kicked into the blocked list. `rpm` / `rate` throttles are recorded but never kick (their buckets heal in seconds; kicking only loses prompt cache).
- **Floor** — when only 1 key remains in running, it is never kicked; the pool never empties and agent requests always go out.
- **401 (invalid credential)** — permanently disabled and removed from the pool, regardless of `quotaRotation`.
- **Session stickiness** — after a rotation the session sticks to the new key (protects the server-side prompt cache); a successful request clears stickiness so the round-robin cursor drives the next pick.
- **Probe limitation** — the blocked-key probe is a minimal request (`max_tokens: 1`, thinking off), so it only reflects the request-count bucket, not full TPM recovery of large requests; real availability of large requests is judged by the agent request itself.

readme.section: Rotation: retry in place first, then switch keys
Why it "runs stably over the long term"
readme.text: None of the key parameters are guesses; they were **calibrated in long-running measurement**:

readme.section: Why it "runs stably over the long term"
readme.text:
| Measured item | Conclusion | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| 429 order | **In-plugin retry once first, then switch keys** (deepseek-flash 15s / v4-flash 10s) | 6 forced-429 rounds: 100% vs 67% success, 27.9s vs 36.9s |
| `quotaRotation` | **On** (key switching is a cheap lottery: 0.2s per key) | Same test: without it the host backs off 17s per retry, hitting 45-50s after two rounds |
| Keys per account | 20 keys reach **90%** success (single key 30%); knee at 15-20 | 10 rounds × 5 levels, peak hour |
| Pool capacity | **100** (fits 4 accounts × 20 keys) | 2026-10 expansion measurement |
| Probe interval | **Fixed 3s** (`probeBackoffFactor=1`, no growth) | Tightened: recovers blocked keys faster |
| Probe scheduling | At most 1 key probed per tick (avoid probe-induced bursts) | by design |
| Dual-list state machine | Replaces the whole-pool-saturation positive-feedback deadlock | refactor |
| Wrap-around rotation fix | After an exclusion, wrap from the next position | 9265 logged 429s |
| Retry-After cap | raised to `60_000ms` (original 3000ms mismatched the TPM 60s window) | long-run |
| Queue timeout | default 60s, aligned with the TPM window | design D4/D6 |

readme.section: Why it "runs stably over the long term"

readme.text:
- Pool-level singleton, shared across sessions: a key's quota is a global property and must not be session-isolated.
- Consecutive-throttle kick-out, floor-never-empty, longest-blocked borrowing, probe recovery, fixed 3s probe — all configurable.
- Each key's state (phase, strikes, blockedSince, probeAttempts) is read-only in the settings page.

- Default account + extra accounts, same base URL.
- Wrap-around rotation + sticky key-switch on quota-type 429s + permanent disable on 401.
- A disabled key auto-recovers when its credential changes.

- Every throttle becomes a structured event, written asynchronously — **never blocks, never throws**.
- Fields: `time / model / error.code / account fingerprint / retryFloorMs / probeHits / poolRunning / poolBlocked / rotated / attempt`.
- Keys live only in memory; logs write only **sha256 fingerprints**; raw keys never touch disk or leave the machine.

- Answers: **which model am I using? what does it support? which parameters can I change?**
- Sourced from the host's actual parsing plus multiple measurement rounds.

- **Export**: pull every account key (default included) into the text box in `account N` groups — local only, never uploaded.
- **Import**: paste `account N + index:key` groups or single `label:key` lines → **staged as a draft** (the Save button lights up); press Save to actually write the credentials and update accounts. A label matching an existing account overwrites that key.

- **Clear**: “Clear box” empties the import/export text; the accounts card gains “Clear all” — after a second confirmation the extra accounts are **staged for removal**; press Save to actually delete the accounts and their credentials (the default account is kept).
